<!-- source: AGENTS.md -->

# AGENTS.md — working on MiuJS

Instructions for coding agents (and humans) changing this repo.

## Layout

- `packages/miujs` — core (`miujs`): router, `t` schemas, errors, app, OpenAPI, MCP, WebSockets, Node adapter.
- `packages/<name>` — official batteries, published as `@miujs/<name>` (auth, session, cache, queue, db, realtime, ratelimit, bots, cli, ...).
- `examples/*` — runnable apps. `bench/` — benchmarks.

Bun workspaces link packages, so `import { miu } from "miujs"` works everywhere in the repo.

## Commands

```bash
bun test                        # whole suite
bun test packages/cache         # one package
bun run typecheck               # tsc --noEmit over the repo
```

On this machine Bun may not be on PATH: use `~/.bun/bin/bun`.

## Rules

1. **Test first.** Write the failing test, watch it fail for the right reason, then write the minimal code. Tests live in `packages/<pkg>/test/*.test.ts` and use `bun:test`. No mocks of our own code; use real in-memory adapters.
2. **Erasable TypeScript only.** No `enum`, `namespace`, parameter properties or decorators. Files must run with type-stripping. Import local files with the `.ts` extension.
3. **Web standards only** in runtime code: `Request`, `Response`, `Headers`, `crypto.subtle`, `URL`. No `node:*` imports outside `packages/miujs/src/node.ts` and code that only runs on Bun/Node (guard with `detectRuntime()`).
4. **No `eval` / `new Function`** — Cloudflare Workers forbid them.
5. **Errors are `MiuError`s** with a stable `MIU_E_*` code, a human message, and a `fix` that tells the reader what to change. Use `errors.*` from `miujs`.
6. **One obvious way.** Each battery exposes one API and swaps backends via adapters. Defaults need zero config (in-memory or SQLite locally; Cloudflare bindings on Workers).
7. Do not commit unless asked.

## Core API in one screen

```ts
import { miu, route, t, errors, definePlugin, type Context } from "miujs";

export const getUser = route.get("/users/:id", {
  summary: "Get a user by id",              // becomes the MCP tool description
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),    // also: query, body, response
  auth: "required",                        // or { role: "admin" }, "optional", false
  handler: async ({ params, user, env, log, cookies, set, waitUntil }) => {
    if (params.id !== user.id) throw errors.forbidden();
    return { id: params.id };              // object → JSON; string → text; undefined → 204; Response → as-is
  },
});

const app = miu({ name: "demo", routes: [getUser], plugins: [], mcp: true });
export default app;                        // Bun / Deno serve / Workers
// await app.listen(3000);                 // or start a server yourself
```

### Plugins (how batteries plug in)

```ts
export const myPlugin = (opts = {}) => definePlugin({
  name: "my-plugin",
  routes: [/* extra RouteDefs */],
  setup(app) { /* once, before first request; app.on("queue" | "scheduled", fn) for Workers */ },
  onRequest(ctx) { /* after route match, before auth/validation; return a Response to stop */ },
  onResponse(ctx, res) { /* every response, incl. errors; return a Response to replace */ },
  mcpTools() { return []; },               // extra MCP tools
  inspect() { return { /* shown in miu inspect */ } },
});

// Typed context fields via module augmentation:
declare module "miujs" {
  interface Context { cache: CacheClient }
}
```

`ctx.state` is free per-request storage for plugins. `ctx.env` holds env vars (Bun/Deno/Node) or bindings (Workers). `ctx.runtime` is `"bun" | "deno" | "node" | "workerd"`.

### WebSockets

`ctx.upgrade({ data, open(ws), message(ws, msg), close(ws, code, reason) })` returns a `Response` to return from the handler. Works on Bun (via `app.websocket` / `app.listen`), Deno and Workers (`WebSocketPair`).

### Testing helpers

- `await app.fetch(new Request("http://localhost/path"))` — full pipeline, no network.
- `await app.call(routeDef, { params, query, body, headers })` → `{ status, body, text, headers, expectStatus(n) }`.
- Route modules may export `tests = { "name": async (call) => {...} }`; `app.tests` collects them and `miu test` runs them.
- `app.inspect()` (after `await app.ready()`) and `app.openapi()` describe the app as JSON.

<!-- source: README.md -->

# MiuJS

A fast TypeScript web framework that runs with **no build step**, is tuned for **Bun**, also
runs on **Deno, Node and Cloudflare Workers**, and makes every route usable by **AI agents**
(MCP + OpenAPI out of the box).

```ts
import { miu, route, t, errors } from "miujs";

export const getUser = route.get("/users/:id", {
  summary: "Get a user by id",
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  response: t.object({ id: t.string(), name: t.string() }),
  handler: ({ params }) => {
    if (params.id !== "1") throw errors.notFound("user", params.id);
    return { id: "1", name: "Mia" };
  },
});

export default miu({ name: "hello", routes: [getUser], mcp: true });
```

```bash
bun app.ts          # Bun serves the default export
deno serve app.ts   # Deno
wrangler deploy     # Cloudflare Workers (or: miu deploy cloudflare)
```

> Status: **0.2 preview**: the core, the CLI, 16 batteries and the admin/CRM, game and 3D tour kits are built and tested (3,300+ tests, soak-tested for memory and shutdown). Not yet deployed to a real Cloudflare account or published to npm. APIs may still change. See [the spec](https://claude.ai/code/artifact/cea50b68-c0e3-4821-a540-fb6b0f4903fc) for the full plan.

## Why MiuJS

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **One schema per route** | `t.object(...)` gives types, validation, OpenAPI, the MCP tool schema and test helpers. |
| **Agent-native** | `mcp: true` serves every route as an MCP tool at `/mcp`. `miu inspect --json` describes the whole app. Errors carry a stable `MIU_E_*` code and a `fix`. |
| **No build** | Erasable TypeScript, run as written. Validators are composed at startup without `eval`, so they work on Workers. |
| **Batteries** | Auth (passwords, OAuth, passkeys), sessions, SQL + Drizzle, cache, queues, files, mail, permissions, audit log, rate limits, workflows, AI and realtime rooms as official `@miujs/*` packages with swappable adapters (memory/SQLite/Redis/S3 locally, Cloudflare bindings in production). |
| **Games** | `@miujs/realtime` rooms run on Durable Objects or in-process — enough for a Kahoot-style quiz. `@miujs/game` adds matchmaking, lobbies, leaderboards and Unity/Godot clients. See [examples/quiz](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/quiz). |
| **Bot-aware** | `@miujs/bots` tells humans from search engines, AI crawlers and scrapers (Cloudflare bot score, user agent, headers) and reads the visitor's country. Block them, give them partial data, or answer from a cache so they never touch your database. |
| **Back office** | `@miujs/admin` turns resource definitions into a CRM-style admin with tables, CSV import/export, a visual workflow builder, and a System area where every installed package shows its status, lists, settings and actions (also as MCP tools, permission-checked and audited). |
| **Fast and lean** | Starts in ~11 ms, validates JSON bodies faster than Elysia and Hono, and keeps memory flat under load (see [Performance](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/README.md#performance)). |

## Packages

| Package | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`miujs`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/miujs) | Core: router, `t` schemas, errors, app, OpenAPI, MCP, WebSockets, Node adapter |
| [`@miujs/cli`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cli) | `miu new / dev / test / inspect / openapi / check / add / deploy` |
| [`@miujs/auth`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/auth) | Email + password, API tokens, roles, legacy hash verification |
| [`@miujs/session`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/session) | Signed-cookie or server-side sessions, flash, CSRF protection |
| [`@miujs/db`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/db) | D1-compatible SQL on SQLite (Bun) and Cloudflare D1, migrations; Postgres over Hyperdrive with Drizzle |
| [`@miujs/cache`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cache) | `remember()`, tags, memory LRU or Cloudflare KV |
| [`@miujs/queue`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/queue) | Typed jobs, retries with backoff, cron schedules, Cloudflare Queues |
| [`@miujs/realtime`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime) | Authoritative rooms over WebSockets, Durable Objects, join codes, sharding, React/Vue/Svelte bindings |
| [`@miujs/files`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/files) | Uploads, signed URLs, resumable uploads; memory, disk, R2 and S3 stores |
| [`@miujs/web`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/web) | Static files, HTML templates and JSX without a build, htmx, Vite, security headers |
| [`@miujs/mail`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/mail) | Email templates and transports (Resend, HTTP), dev preview |
| [`@miujs/access`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/access) | Roles, permissions, per-record policies, organizations and invites |
| [`@miujs/audit`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/audit) | Tamper-evident audit log (HMAC hash chain, external anchors) |
| [`@miujs/workflows`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/workflows) | Durable automation: events, cron, webhooks, sleeps, approvals, JSON workflows |
| [`@miujs/ratelimit`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ratelimit) | Rate limits by route, path or tag; memory, KV, Durable Object, Redis |
| [`@miujs/bots`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/bots) | Bot, AI crawler and location detection; block, trim or serve cached responses to crawlers |
| [`@miujs/ai`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ai) | Claude, OpenAI-compatible and Workers AI; structured output, tool loops, RAG |
| [`@miujs/migrate`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/migrate) | Port Laravel, Django or FastAPI apps route by route (proxy, shared sessions, contract tests) |
| [`@miujs/admin`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/admin) | Admin + CRM kit: resources become tables, API, MCP tools and an admin UI; visual workflow builder; System area for every package |
| [`@miujs/game`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/game) | Game kit: matchmaking, lobbies, game rooms with timers, leaderboards, achievements, Unity/Godot clients |
| [`@miujs/tour`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/tour) | 3D and 360° tours: scenes, hotspots, floor plans, tiling jobs, live guided tours, analytics, field encryption |

Full guide: [docs/guide.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/guide.md). Every error code: [docs/errors.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Architecture

```
 Requests: browsers, apps, MCP agents, search and AI crawlers
     │
     ▼
 Visitor gate (@miujs/bots, optional) ── block (403) or cached copy ──▶ answered here: no handler, no DB
     │ full or partial
     ▼
 Your app: route files, rooms, jobs, workflows (plain TypeScript, no build)
     │
     ▼
 MiuJS core: router, t schemas, errors, plugins    Agent layer: MCP, OpenAPI, inspect    CLI (miu)
     │
     ▼
 Kits: admin (back office, CRM) · game · tour
     │
     ▼
 Batteries: auth session db cache queue realtime files web mail access audit workflows ratelimit ai migrate bots
     │
     ├─▶ Cloudflare bindings: D1, KV, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, Workflows, Cache API, bot score and geo
     └─▶ Local and self-hosted: SQLite, memory, disk, Redis, S3, HTTP mail
     │
     ▼
 Runtimes: Cloudflare Workers · Bun · Deno · Node
```

Your code talks only to the core and the battery APIs. The adapter under each battery is picked
by where the app runs, so the same files deploy to Workers, Bun, Deno or Node.

**Request path**, in order:

1. **Visitor gate** (`@miujs/bots`): classifies the caller (human, search, AI crawler, bot,
   unknown), reads location, then blocks, serves a cached copy, trims the response, or lets it
   through. Signed-in users, MCP and `/_miu/*` are never affected.
2. **Plugin `onRequest` hooks** in the order listed (session, auth, rate limits, access).
3. **Router and validation**: params, query and body checked against the route's schemas; bodies
   capped at `maxBodySize`.
4. **Handler**, then `onResponse` hooks (the bot cache stores eligible responses here).
5. **Background work** (`waitUntil`, jobs, room timers). `app.close()` drains it and calls each
   plugin's `stop()`, so processes exit cleanly.

## Core concepts

### Routes

```ts
route.post("/orders", {
  summary: "Create an order",            // shown to agents as the tool description
  body: t.object({ sku: t.string(), qty: t.integer({ min: 1 }) }),
  query: t.object({ dryRun: t.default(t.boolean(), false) }),
  response: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  status: 201,
  auth: "required",                      // or { role: "admin" }, "optional"
  handler: async ({ body, query, user, log, set, cookies, env, waitUntil }) => ({ id: "o_1" }),
});
```

Return an object (JSON), a string (text), `undefined` (204), bytes/stream, or any `Response`.
Params and query are coerced from strings. Unknown body keys are dropped. In dev, responses are
checked against `response`.

### Errors

```json
{ "error": { "code": "MIU_E_VALIDATION", "message": "Invalid body: body.qty must be >= 1",
  "fix": "Send body that matches the route schema (see /_miu/openapi.json or the MCP tool input schema).",
  "docs": "https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_validation", "details": { "issues": [...] } } }
```

Configuration mistakes fail at startup with the same shape, e.g. `MIU_E_PARAM_MISSING` when a
path has `:id` but the params schema doesn't.

### Plugins

```ts
const timing = definePlugin({
  name: "timing",
  onRequest(ctx) { ctx.state.start = performance.now(); },
  onResponse(ctx, res) { res.headers.set("server-timing", `app;dur=${performance.now() - (ctx.state.start as number)}`); },
});
```

Plugins can add routes, MCP tools, Workers `queue`/`scheduled` handlers, typed context fields
(module augmentation) and the Cloudflare bindings they need.

### MCP and OpenAPI

- `miu({ mcp: true })` → `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Tools are built from route schemas; a
  tool call runs the real route, so auth and validation apply. Point Claude or any MCP client at it.
- `GET /_miu/openapi.json` (dev, or `openapi: true`), `GET /_miu/app.json` (dev), `miu inspect --json`.

### Testing

```ts
export const tests = {
  "returns 404 for unknown id": async (call: CallFn) => {
    (await call(getUser, { params: { id: "nope" } })).expectStatus(404);
  },
};
```

`miu test` runs every route file's `tests`. For unit tests use `bun test` with
`app.fetch(new Request(...))` or `app.call(route, input)`.

### Realtime rooms (games, quizzes, chat)

```ts
import { defineRoom, rooms } from "@miujs/realtime";

export const quiz = defineRoom("quiz", {
  state: t.object({ phase: t.enum(["lobby", "question", "reveal"]), scores: t.record(t.number()) }),
  secret: () => ({ correct: 2 }),                        // server-only state, never sent to clients
  client: { answer: t.object({ choice: t.integer() }) },
  init: () => ({ phase: "lobby" as const, scores: {} }),
  on: {
    answer: ({ room, sender, msg }) => {
      if (msg.choice === room.secret.correct) room.state.scores[sender.id] = (room.state.scores[sender.id] ?? 0) + 1000;
    },
  },
});

miu({ plugins: [rooms({ rooms: [quiz] })] });          // ws://host/rooms/quiz/<id>
```

State changes are sent to every player as patches. On Cloudflare each room is a Durable Object
(`createRoomDurableObject`); locally it lives in memory. The wire protocol is documented in
[PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/PROTOCOL.md) so Unity or Godot clients can join. The full
Kahoot-style game is in [examples/quiz](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/quiz); a notes API using every other battery
is in [examples/api](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/api).

## CLI

```bash
miu new my-app                  # project with app.ts, routes/, AGENTS.md
miu dev                         # bun --hot
miu add route users/get-profile # route file + failing test
miu test                        # route tests
miu inspect [--json]            # routes, schemas, plugins, MCP tools
miu check                       # leaked secrets, mutations without auth
miu deploy cloudflare           # wrangler.toml from your plugins, then wrangler deploy
```

## Performance

In-process `fetch()` on Bun 1.4.3 against Elysia and Hono (Windows laptop, best of 3 rounds;
compare within a row, since absolute numbers move ±10% between runs):

| Scenario | MiuJS | Compared with the fastest of Elysia and Hono |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `POST /json`, body validation → JSON | ~400k req/s | **94–111%** (usually fastest) |
| `GET /users/:id`, params → JSON | ~1M req/s | **95–103%** |
| `GET /` text, called the way `Bun.serve` calls it | ~1.5M req/s | 83–101% |
| `GET /` text, plain `app.fetch(req)` | ~1.3M req/s | 81–91% |
| Cold start, process start → first response | **~11 ms** | Hono ~13 ms, Elysia ~53 ms |

MiuJS gets there without generating code at runtime (Workers forbid `eval` and `new Function`):
each route picks a specialized dispatcher at startup, unconstrained string params skip a no-op
validation, and repeated text responses are cloned from a cached `Response`. CI fails a pull
request that drops any of these ratios by more than 5% (`bench/compare.ts`).

Over real HTTP all three frameworks hit the same loopback ceiling (~72k req/s on this
machine). Memory kept per 10,000 requests is about zero for all three. Method and history:
[bench/README.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/bench/README.md); run it with `bun bench/run.ts` (`BENCH_HTTP=1` adds HTTP).

**On Cloudflare's runtime** (workerd, run locally with `bun run workerd`;
[report](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/scripts/workerd/REPORT.md)): the core bundle is **16.2 KB gzipped** (target under 60 KB),
the first request after a fresh start takes ~14 ms for the core alone and ~30 ms with auth, session
and cache, and a D1 read with a session check has p99 9.3 ms. These are local numbers, not edge
numbers.

**Memory and stability** ([soak report](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/scripts/soak/REPORT.md)): the example apps ran under
sustained load over real HTTP and WebSockets on Bun, Node and Deno.

- Heap stays flat on every runtime. Every package has a leak test (forced-GC rounds, bytes and
  objects per iteration) and an exit test (a process using it exits on its own).
- Shutdown takes 12–46 ms, and no request or socket is left hanging after clients disconnect.
- Fixes from the soak include:
  - **Sign-ins:** argon2id is capped at 19 MiB per hash and 4 hashes at a time. 32 concurrent
    sign-ins went from +1.3 GB to +78 MB.
  - **Game rooms:** finished rooms now close 5 s after the result. Live rooms after load went
    from 22,726 to 0, and heap from 132 MB to 3 MB.
  - **Long-polls:** they stop when the client disconnects.
  - **JSON bodies:** the read is faster, and peak heap per 10,000 requests dropped from 288 KB to 8 KB.

## Security defaults

- **Sessions:** signed (HMAC-SHA256) `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax` cookies; the id is rotated on login.
  Unsafe requests that carry the cookie must come from the same origin (or a `trustedOrigins` site).
- **Login CSRF:** `/auth/login`, `/auth/register` and `/auth/logout` are tagged `csrf-always`.
  Cross-site browser requests are rejected (403 `MIU_E_CSRF`) even without a cookie. Clients that
  send no `Origin` (curl, servers) still work.
- **Brute force:** login is limited to 10 attempts per IP+account, 50 per account and 100 per IP per
  15 minutes. Register is limited to 10 per IP per hour. Over the limit gives 429 with `Retry-After`.
  - The client IP is `ctx.ip`: Cloudflare's address on Workers, the socket address on Bun. Behind
    your own proxy, set `miu({ trustProxy: { header: "x-forwarded-for" } })` (it reads the entry your
    proxy appended, never the client-supplied one).
  - The default limiter keeps counts in memory, which is exact on one server. On Workers each
    isolate counts separately, so use `cloudflareRateLimiter("BINDING")` and/or Turnstile.
- **Account enumeration:** login gives the same error and timing for unknown emails and wrong
  passwords. With `auth({ emailVerification: "required" })`, register and password reset answer
  the same way whether or not the email exists. With verification off, register still returns 409
  for a taken email, and the register limit keeps probing slow.
- **OAuth and passkeys:** provider sign-in links only to accounts whose email is verified, never
  taking over an existing account; signed-in users link and unlink providers explicitly. Passkeys
  use single-use server-side challenges and sign-counter clone detection.
- **Password reset** signs out other sessions and revokes API tokens.
- **API tokens:** shown once and stored as SHA-256 hashes. Passwords use argon2id on Bun, otherwise
  PBKDF2 (600k iterations). Legacy bcrypt and Django hashes are upgraded on the next login.

## Roadmap

MiuJS grows in four phases. Each phase ends with a starter template (`miu new --template ...`)
that runs end to end. The full plan is in the
[spec](https://claude.ai/code/artifact/cea50b68-c0e3-4821-a540-fb6b0f4903fc).

| Phase | Status | What it adds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1. Foundations** | Done | `@miujs/files` (uploads, signed URLs, resumable uploads, R2), `@miujs/web` (static files, HTML/JSX without a build, htmx, Vite, security headers), `@miujs/access` (roles, per-record policies, organizations, invites), `@miujs/audit` (tamper-evident audit log), `@miujs/mail` (+ email verification and password reset), `@miujs/workflows` (durable automation) |
| **2. Admin + CRM kit** | Done (preview) | Define a resource once and get tables, API, MCP tools, lifecycle events and an admin UI. Pipelines, tasks, search, CSV import/export, and a visual workflow builder |
| **3. Game kit** | Done (preview) | Room timers on Durable Object alarms, matchmaking and lobbies, join codes, leaderboards, achievements, Unity/Godot clients |
| **4. 3D tour kit** | Done (preview) | 360° tiling and 3D model compression jobs, hotspots and floor plans, live guided tours, viewing analytics. Healthcare building blocks: field encryption, consent, retention |
| **5. Hardening** | Done | Leak and exit tests for every package, soak tests over HTTP and WebSockets, memory caps for password hashing, faster body reads, `app.close()` |
| **6. Traffic and operations** | Done (preview) | `@miujs/bots` (done): bot, AI crawler and location detection with block / partial / cached / full. Admin System area (done): every package shows its status, lists, settings and actions in the admin and as MCP tools |
| **7. Release readiness** | Done (preview) | Example apps run on Cloudflare's runtime locally (`bun run workerd`, 70 scenarios), npm packages verified on Node, Deno, Bun and a Workers bundle, Postgres over Hyperdrive (`@miujs/db/postgres`, [guide](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/postgres.md)), per-route fast paths, CI benchmark gate |
| **Next** | Needs accounts | First deploy to a real Cloudflare account (edge bot score and geo, CPU limits, Queues at scale), first npm publish (needs the `@miujs` scope and the `miujs` name) |

### Automation workflows

Workflows are durable: a run survives restarts and deploys while it sleeps or waits for an event.

```ts
export const followUp = defineWorkflow("contact-follow-up", {
  trigger: on("contact.created"),
  input: t.object({ contactId: t.string(), email: t.string() }),
  run: async ({ input, step }) => {
    const lead = await step.run("enrich", () => enrich(input.email));   // journaled, retried
    await step.sleep("wait-a-day", "1d");
    const reply = await step.waitForEvent("reply", { event: "email.replied", match: { "data.contactId": input.contactId }, timeout: "3d" });
    if (!reply) await step.run("follow-up", () => sendFollowUp(lead));
  },
});
```

- **Triggers:** events, cron schedules, signed webhooks, or a manual start.
- **Control:** approvals, retries, cancel and retry-from-failed-step, and run history.
- **AI agents:** MCP tools so agents can start and inspect runs.
- **No-code:** the same engine runs JSON-defined workflows, which the admin's visual builder
  produces.

## Known limitations (0.2)

- **Cloudflare:** never deployed to a real account. `bun run workerd` runs the example apps on
  Cloudflare's runtime locally (workerd through `wrangler dev --local`, with Miniflare's D1, KV, R2,
  Queues, Durable Objects, Workflows, rate limits and Cache API) over real HTTP and WebSockets; see
  [scripts/workerd/REPORT.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/scripts/workerd/REPORT.md). Still unverified without an account: edge
  bot scores and geo, CPU-time limits, Queues delivery timing and retries at scale, latency between
  locations. Pending `after`/`tick` room timers are lost when a Durable Object hibernates.
- **Deno and Node:** `bun run smoke` runs the same HTTP checks on Bun, Node 24 and Deno 2 (routing,
  validation, body limits, cookies, `ctx.ip`, MCP, `waitUntil`); all pass. The full test suite runs on
  Bun only. Node won't strip types inside `node_modules`, so the npm build ships prebuilt JS and
  `.d.ts` for Node and Deno (Bun still loads the TypeScript source).
- **Speed:** level with Elysia on params and validated bodies. A trivial text route is still
  9–19% behind when called as plain `app.fetch(req)`: MiuJS keeps `content-type` on the Response
  object (tests and plugins rely on it) and pays ~30–50 ns of generic dispatch that only runtime code
  generation would remove, which Workers forbid ([bench](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/bench/README.md)).
- **Bot detection:** without Cloudflare's bot score, detection relies on user agents and headers,
  so a crawler that copies a browser's headers passes as human.
- **Verified only against fakes:** Redis and S3 adapters (fake servers, AWS signature test vectors),
  Laravel/Django session crypto (independent reference ports, no real PHP/Python app yet), OAuth
  providers and the Anthropic/Workers AI APIs (recorded shapes, no live calls).
- **Not on npm yet:** the packages are release-ready (prebuilt JS and `.d.ts` for Node, Deno and
  bundlers; TypeScript source for Bun), and `bun scripts/release/verify.ts` installs the packed
  tarballs on Node 24, Deno 2, Bun, a Workers bundle and strict `tsc`. Publishing waits on the
  `@miujs` npm scope and the unscoped `miujs` name, which another project owns
  ([RELEASING.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/RELEASING.md)).

## Developing MiuJS

```bash
bun install
bun test
bun run typecheck
```

Read [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md) for the rules (test-first, erasable TypeScript, web standards only).

## License

Dual-licensed: [AGPL-3.0](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/LICENSE) for everyone, or a paid commercial license if you can't
release your source under the AGPL. See [COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).

<!-- source: docs/guide.md -->

# Getting started with MiuJS

This guide takes you from an empty folder to a tested API that AI agents can call, deployed to
Cloudflare Workers. Each package has its own README with the full API; this page links to them.

MiuJS is at 0.1: APIs may still change, and the packages are not on npm yet. Until they are,
work inside a clone of the repo (`bun install` links the workspace packages).

## 1. A new project

```bash
bun add -d @miujs/cli
miu new my-app          # app.ts, routes/health.ts, AGENTS.md, package.json, tsconfig.json
cd my-app && bun install
miu dev                 # bun --hot app.ts
```

The app is the default export of `app.ts`. Bun serves it as-is, `deno serve app.ts` does too, and
it is a complete Cloudflare Worker. On Node, call `await app.listen(3000)`.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";

// miu new puts this in routes/health.ts; app.ts then does `import * as health from "./routes/health.ts"`.
export const health = route.get("/health", {
  summary: "Check that the app is up",
  response: t.object({ ok: t.boolean() }),
  handler: () => ({ ok: true }),
});

export default miu({ name: "my-app", routes: [{ health }], mcp: true });
```

Passing a route module (or any object of routes) registers every route in it, named after its
export, and collects its `tests`. See [`@miujs/cli`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cli/README.md) for every command.

## 2. Routes and schemas

One `t` schema per input gives you validation, TypeScript types, OpenAPI and the MCP tool schema.
Params and query are coerced from strings; unknown body keys are dropped.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { route, t } from "miujs";

export const createOrder = route.post("/orders", {
  summary: "Create an order", // agents see this as the tool description
  body: t.object({ sku: t.string(), qty: t.integer({ min: 1 }) }),
  query: t.object({ dryRun: t.default(t.boolean(), false) }),
  response: t.object({ id: t.string(), qty: t.integer() }),
  status: 201,
  auth: "required", // or "optional", false, { role: "admin" }
  handler: async ({ body, query, user, log }) => {
    log.info("order", { user: user.id, dryRun: query.dryRun });
    return { id: "o_1", qty: body.qty };
  },
});
```

A handler returns an object (JSON), a string (text), `undefined` (204) or any `Response`. In dev,
responses are checked against `response`. The schema builders (`t.string`, `t.enum`, `t.array`,
`t.union`, `t.optional`, ...) are listed in the [`miujs` README](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/miujs/README.md#schemas).

## 3. Errors

Throw `errors.*` instead of plain `Error`s. Every error has a stable `MIU_E_*` code, a message and a
`fix` that says what to change:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { errors, route, t } from "miujs";

export const getUser = route.get("/users/:id", {
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  handler: ({ params }) => {
    if (params.id !== "1") throw errors.notFound("user", params.id);
    return { id: "1", name: "Mia" };
  },
});
```

```json
{ "error": { "code": "MIU_E_NOT_FOUND", "message": "user \"2\" not found",
  "docs": "https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_not_found" } }
```

Configuration mistakes fail at startup with the same shape, for example `MIU_E_PARAM_MISSING` when
a path has `:id` but the params schema doesn't. Every code is in [errors.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## 4. Plugins

Batteries are plugins. Each adds typed fields to the handler context and picks a local or
Cloudflare backend on its own:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { cache } from "@miujs/cache";
import { db } from "@miujs/db";

const migrations = [{ id: "001_notes", sql: "CREATE TABLE notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL);" }];

export const listNotes = route.get("/notes", {
  query: t.object({ limit: t.default(t.integer({ min: 1, max: 100 }), 20) }),
  handler: async ({ query, db, cache }) =>
    cache.remember(`notes:${query.limit}`, 30, async () => {
      const { results } = await db.prepare("SELECT id, body FROM notes ORDER BY id LIMIT ?").bind(query.limit).all();
      return { notes: results };
    }),
});

export default miu({ name: "notes", routes: [listNotes], plugins: [db({ migrations }), cache()] });
```

| Package | Adds |
| --- | --- |
| [`@miujs/auth`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/auth/README.md) | Email and password accounts, API tokens, roles (`user`, `auth: "required"`) |
| [`@miujs/session`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/session/README.md) | Signed-cookie or server-side sessions, flash, CSRF protection |
| [`@miujs/db`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/db/README.md) | D1-compatible SQL on SQLite or Cloudflare D1, migrations; [Postgres over Hyperdrive](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/postgres.md) |
| [`@miujs/cache`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cache/README.md) | `remember()`, tags; memory, KV or Redis |
| [`@miujs/queue`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/queue/README.md) | Typed jobs, retries, cron; Cloudflare Queues |
| [`@miujs/ratelimit`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ratelimit/README.md) | Rate limiting rules |
| [`@miujs/bots`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/bots/README.md) | Detect bots, AI crawlers and visitor location; block them or serve them cached responses |
| [`@miujs/realtime`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/README.md) | Authoritative rooms over WebSockets, Durable Objects |
| [`@miujs/files`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/files/README.md) | Uploads and signed URLs; disk, R2, S3 |
| [`@miujs/web`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/web/README.md) | HTML and JSX without a build, static files, htmx, security headers |
| [`@miujs/mail`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/mail/README.md) | Transactional email |
| [`@miujs/access`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/access/README.md) | Roles, permissions, per-record policies, organizations |
| [`@miujs/audit`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/audit/README.md) | Tamper-evident audit log |
| [`@miujs/workflows`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/workflows/README.md) | Durable workflows with steps, sleeps and events |
| [`@miujs/ai`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ai/README.md) | Model calls, tool use over your routes, RAG |

Your own plugin is a `definePlugin({ name, routes, setup, onRequest, onResponse, mcpTools, inspect })`;
see [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md#plugins-how-batteries-plug-in).

## 5. MCP for AI agents

With `mcp: true` every route is an MCP tool at `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP). A tool call runs the
real route, so auth and validation apply, and errors come back with their `fix`. Routes with
`mcp: false` are hidden.

```bash
bun app.ts                                          # serves on http://localhost:3000
claude mcp add --transport http my-app http://localhost:3000/mcp
miu inspect --json                                  # what agents (and you) can see
```

`GET /_miu/openapi.json` serves OpenAPI 3.1 in dev (or with `openapi: true`).

## 6. Testing

`app.call(route, input)` runs the full pipeline without a network and returns
`{ status, body, text, headers, expectStatus(n) }`. Use it from `bun test`:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { errors, miu, route, t } from "miujs";

const getUser = route.get("/users/:id", {
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  handler: ({ params }) => {
    if (params.id !== "1") throw errors.notFound("user", params.id);
    return { id: "1", name: "Mia" };
  },
});
const app = miu({ routes: [getUser], logLevel: "silent" });

test("unknown users are 404 with a stable code", async () => {
  const res = await app.call(getUser, { params: { id: "2" } });
  res.expectStatus(404);
  expect(res.body.error.code).toBe("MIU_E_NOT_FOUND");
});

test("the full HTTP pipeline", async () => {
  const res = await app.fetch(new Request("http://localhost/users/1"));
  expect(await res.json()).toEqual({ id: "1", name: "Mia" });
});
```

Route files can also export `tests = { "name": async (call) => { ... } }`; `miu test` runs them.
`miu check` looks for leaked secrets and mutations without `auth`.

## 7. Deploy to Cloudflare Workers

```bash
miu deploy cloudflare --dry-run   # write wrangler.toml from your plugins and print it
miu deploy cloudflare             # write it, then bunx wrangler deploy (needs wrangler login)
wrangler secret put SESSION_SECRET
```

Plugins declare the bindings they need (KV for cache, D1 for db, Queues, R2, Durable Objects for
realtime rooms), and `miu deploy cloudflare` turns them into `wrangler.toml`. Secrets are never
written to it; set them with `wrangler secret put`. On Workers, `ctx.env` holds your bindings and
`app.listen()` is not available: the default export is the Worker.

Cloudflare support is tested against in-test fakes but has not been deployed to a real account yet;
see the README's [known limitations](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/README.md#known-limitations-01).

## Next

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md): the rules for changing a MiuJS app (test first, erasable TypeScript, web standards).
- [errors.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md): every error code with its fix.
- [examples/api](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/api) and [examples/quiz](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/quiz): a notes API using the batteries and a Kahoot-style quiz.
- [llms.txt](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/llms.txt): an index of these docs for LLMs.

<!-- source: packages/miujs/README.md -->

# miujs

> Core of MiuJS: a no-build TypeScript web framework with typed routes, `t` schemas, stable error codes, plugins, MCP and OpenAPI, for Bun, Deno, Node and Cloudflare Workers.

`miujs` gives you `miu()` (the app), `route.*` (handlers with their schemas), `t` (validation that also produces JSON Schema), `errors.*` (`MiuError`s with a `MIU_E_*` code and a `fix`) and `definePlugin()`. One route definition drives validation, TypeScript types, OpenAPI, MCP tools and test helpers. Use it on its own for an API, or add the `@miujs/*` batteries as plugins.

## Install

```bash
bun add miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { errors, miu, route, t } from "miujs";

export const getUser = route.get("/users/:id", {
  summary: "Get a user by id",
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  response: t.object({ id: t.string(), name: t.string() }),
  handler: ({ params }) => {
    if (params.id !== "1") throw errors.notFound("user", params.id);
    return { id: "1", name: "Mia" };
  },
});

const app = miu({ name: "hello", routes: [getUser], mcp: true });
export default app; // Bun, `deno serve` and Workers serve the default export

const res = await app.call(getUser, { params: { id: "1" } });
res.expectStatus(200);
console.log(res.body); // { id: "1", name: "Mia" }
```

Run it with `bun app.ts`, `deno serve app.ts`, or `await app.listen(3000)`.

## Routes

`route.get | post | put | patch | delete | head | options(path, config)`. Paths use `:name` params and a trailing `*` wildcard. The handler gets `params`, `query`, `body` (typed from the schemas), plus `user`, `env`, `log`, `cookies`, `set`, `state`, `ip`, `waitUntil` and `upgrade`.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { route, t } from "miujs";

export const createOrder = route.post("/orders", {
  summary: "Create an order",
  body: t.object({ sku: t.string(), qty: t.integer({ min: 1 }) }),
  query: t.object({ dryRun: t.default(t.boolean(), false) }),
  response: t.object({ id: t.string(), qty: t.integer() }),
  status: 201,
  auth: "required", // or "optional", false, { role: "admin" }
  handler: async ({ body, query, user, set, log }) => {
    log.info("order", { user: user.id, dryRun: query.dryRun });
    set.headers.set("x-order", "o_1");
    return { id: "o_1", qty: body.qty };
  },
});
```

Return an object (JSON), a string (text), `undefined` or `null` (204), or any `Response`. Params and query are coerced from strings; unknown body keys are dropped. In dev mode responses are checked against `response`.

A string is served as `text/plain; charset=utf-8`. When Bun's own server calls the app (`export default app` or `app.listen()` on Bun), no `onResponse` plugin is installed, the method isn't `HEAD` and the route set no headers, the header is left off the `Response` object and Bun adds `text/plain;charset=utf-8` on the wire, which saves ~120 ns per text response. Everywhere the object can be seen (`app.fetch(req)` in tests, `app.tools()` calls, MCP, `app.dispatch`, Node, Deno, Workers) it carries the header.

Other route options: `name`, `description`, `tags`, `mcp: false`, `permission` (checked via `ctx.authorize`, provided by `@miujs/access`), `maxBodySize`, `internal`.

## Schemas

`t.string({ minLength, maxLength, pattern, format, secret })`, `t.number({ min, max })`, `t.integer()`, `t.boolean()`, `t.date()`, `t.literal(v)`, `t.enum([...])`, `t.array(item, { min, max })`, `t.object(shape)`, `t.record(value)`, `t.union([...])`, `t.optional(s)`, `t.default(s, value)`, `t.nullable(s)`, `t.any()`, `t.unknown()`. String formats: `uuid`, `email`, `url`, `date`, `date-time`. `secret: true` marks an API key, password or connection string: the JSON Schema gets `writeOnly: true` and `format: "password"` (unless `format` is set), so admin screens and audit logs redact it; validation is unchanged.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { t, validate, type Infer } from "miujs";

const User = t.object({
  email: t.string({ format: "email" }),
  role: t.enum(["admin", "member"]),
  tags: t.optional(t.array(t.string())),
});
type User = Infer<typeof User>;

const r = validate(User, { email: "a@b.co", role: "member" });
if (r.ok) {
  const u: User = r.value;
  console.log(u.role);
} else {
  console.log(r.issues); // [{ path, message }]
}
console.log(User.json); // JSON Schema, as used by OpenAPI and MCP
```

## Errors and plugins

Throw `errors.notFound`, `badRequest`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `conflict`, `tooManyRequests`, `internal`, or `errors.custom({ code, status, message, fix })`. Every error body is:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "MIU_E_NOT_FOUND", "message": "user \"9\" not found",
  "docs": "https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_not_found" } }
```

Plugins add routes, hooks, services, MCP tools and Cloudflare bindings:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { definePlugin, miu, route } from "miujs";

const timing = definePlugin({
  name: "timing",
  onRequest(ctx) {
    ctx.state.start = performance.now();
  },
  onResponse(ctx, res) {
    res.headers.set("server-timing", `app;dur=${performance.now() - (ctx.state.start as number)}`);
  },
  inspect: () => ({ header: "server-timing" }),
});

const app = miu({ routes: [route.get("/", { handler: () => "ok" })], plugins: [timing] });
const res = await app.fetch(new Request("http://localhost/"));
console.log(res.headers.get("server-timing"));
```

Plugin hooks: `setup(app)`, `routes`, `onRequest`, `onResponse`, `onError`, `mcpTools()`, `inspect()`, `cloudflare()`. In `setup`, plugins can call `app.add(...)`, `app.on("queue" | "scheduled", fn)` and `app.provide(name, value)`; code outside requests reads services with `app.service(name)`. Add typed context fields with `declare module "miujs" { interface Context { ... } }`, and typed per-route options with `declare module "miujs" { interface RouteExtensions { myOption?: ... } }`: routes then accept `myOption`, and hooks read it from `ctx.route.config.myOption` (the route's own config object; absent on internal `/_miu/*` and MCP routes).

## MCP, OpenAPI and inspect

- `miu({ mcp: true })` serves every route as an MCP tool at `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP). A tool call dispatches a real request, so auth and validation apply. Routes with `mcp: false` are skipped.
- `GET /_miu/openapi.json` (dev, or `openapi: true`) and `GET /_miu/app.json` (dev only). In code: `app.openapi()`, `app.inspect()` (after `await app.ready()`).
- `app.tools()` returns the same tools with a `call(args, { headers })` method, for model tool use (`@miujs/ai`).

## WebSockets

```ts
route.get("/ws", {
  handler: (ctx) =>
    ctx.upgrade({
      data: { n: 0 },
      message(ws, msg) { ws.data.n++; ws.send(`echo ${msg}`); },
    }),
});
```

Works on Bun (the default export or `app.listen()` carry `websocket`), Deno and Workers (`WebSocketPair`).

## Node

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { serveNode } from "miujs/node";

const app = miu({ routes: [route.get("/hi", { handler: () => ({ hi: true }) })] });
const server = await serveNode(app, { port: 3000, hostname: "127.0.0.1" });
console.log(server.url);
await server.stop();
```

`app.listen()` on Node loads this adapter for you.

## Testing

- `await app.fetch(new Request("http://localhost/path"))` or `await app.request("/path", init)`: full pipeline, no network.
- `await app.call(route, { params, query, body, headers })` returns `{ status, ok, headers, text, body, expectStatus(n) }`.
- Route modules may export `tests = { "name": async (call: CallFn) => {...} }`; `app.tests` collects them and `miu test` runs them.
- `await app.drain()` waits for `waitUntil` work.
- When you call `app.fetch()` yourself, read or cancel every response body (`await res.text()`,
  `await res.body?.cancel()`). A dropped body keeps its source (an open file, an upstream request)
  alive until garbage collection. Servers (`Bun.serve`, `listen()`, Workers) do this for you.
- `await app.close()` waits for background work and calls each plugin's `stop()`, so timers and
  sockets are released and the process can exit. Stopping a `listen()` server calls it for you.
  (It is `close()`, not `stop()`: Bun does not auto-serve a default export that has a `stop`
  member, so `bun app.ts` would exit instead of serving.)

## Options

`miu(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | `"miujs-app"` | App name (MCP server info, OpenAPI title, logs). |
| `version` | `string` | `"0.0.0"` | App version. |
| `routes` | `RouteSource[]` | `[]` | Routes, arrays, or route modules (export names become route names; `tests` are collected). |
| `plugins` | `Plugin[]` | `[]` | Plugins, run in order. |
| `mcp` | `boolean \| McpOptions` | off | Serve routes as MCP tools. `McpOptions`: `path` (default `/mcp`), `instructions`, `include`, `allowedOrigins`. |
| `openapi` | `boolean \| { path?, info? }` | on in dev | Serve OpenAPI 3.1 at `/_miu/openapi.json`. |
| `dev` | `boolean` | on unless `MIU_ENV`/`NODE_ENV` is `production` or on Workers | Response checks and `/_miu/*` routes. |
| `logLevel` | `LogLevel \| "silent"` | `"info"` in dev, else `"warn"` | Logger level. |
| `logRequests` | `boolean` | `false` | One log line per request. |
| `maxBodySize` | `number` | `10485760` (10 MiB) | Largest request body in bytes. Routes can override. |
| `trustProxy` | `{ header: string; hops?: number }` | none | Your reverse proxy's header, so `ctx.ip` is the real client. |

## Errors

- `MIU_E_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`: no route matches the method and path; the `fix` suggests the closest route.
- `MIU_E_NOT_FOUND`: thrown by `errors.notFound()` for a missing resource ([docs](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_not_found)).
- `MIU_E_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`: the path exists for other methods.
- `MIU_E_VALIDATION`: params, query or body do not match the schema; `details.issues` lists each problem.
- `MIU_E_RESPONSE_INVALID`: dev only; the handler returned data that does not match `response`.
- `MIU_E_BAD_JSON`, `MIU_E_BODY_TOO_LARGE`: unreadable or oversized body.
- `MIU_E_UNAUTHORIZED`, `MIU_E_FORBIDDEN`: `auth` requirement not met.
- `MIU_E_PARAM_MISSING`, `MIU_E_ROUTE_DUPLICATE`, `MIU_E_ROUTE_CONFLICT`: route configuration mistakes, thrown at startup.
- `MIU_E_SERVICE_MISSING`, `MIU_E_SERVICE_DUPLICATE`: a plugin service is absent or provided twice.
- `MIU_E_LISTEN_UNSUPPORTED`: `listen()` called on Workers.
- `MIU_E_INTERNAL`: an unexpected exception.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

`export default app` is a complete Worker: `app.fetch(req, env, ctx)`, plus `app.queue` and `app.scheduled` for handlers plugins register with `app.on(...)`. On Workers `ctx.env` holds your bindings and vars, `ctx.waitUntil` uses the execution context, `ctx.ip` comes from Cloudflare, and dev mode is off by default. `app.listen()` throws `MIU_E_LISTEN_UNSUPPORTED`. The core has no `node:*` imports outside `miujs/node`, which is Node only. Plugins declare the bindings they need through `cloudflare()`; `app.inspect().cloudflare` merges them and `miu deploy cloudflare` writes `wrangler.toml` from it.

## Links

- [Getting started guide](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/guide.md)
- [Error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/miujs/src)
- [Tests](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/miujs/test)
- [@miujs/cli](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cli/README.md), [@miujs/web](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/web/README.md), [@miujs/ai](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ai/README.md), [@miujs/auth](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/auth/README.md), [@miujs/cache](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cache/README.md), [@miujs/db](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/db/README.md)

<!-- source: packages/cli/README.md -->

# @miujs/cli

> The `miu` command line: scaffold projects and files, run route tests, inspect apps, check for mistakes, manage SQLite/D1 migrations and deploy to Cloudflare Workers.

`@miujs/cli` installs the `miu` binary. Most commands load your app entry (a file that does `export default miu({...})`), call `await app.ready()` and work from `app.inspect()`, `app.openapi()` and `app.tests`. Use it in development and CI; nothing from it runs inside your deployed app.

## Install

```bash
bun add -d @miujs/cli
bun add miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet). The `miu` binary itself runs on Bun (`#!/usr/bin/env bun`).

## Quick start

An app entry that `miu dev`, `miu test` and `miu inspect` can load:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t, type CallFn } from "miujs";

export const health = route.get("/health", {
  summary: "Check that the app is up",
  response: t.object({ ok: t.boolean() }),
  handler: () => ({ ok: true }),
});

// `miu test` runs these; `call` is app.call.
export const tests = {
  "health returns ok": async (call: CallFn) => {
    const res = await call(health);
    res.expectStatus(200);
  },
};

// Passing the module object registers its routes and collects its `tests`.
export default miu({ name: "my-app", routes: [{ health, tests }], mcp: true });
```

In a real project the route lives in `routes/health.ts` and `app.ts` does `import * as health from "./routes/health.ts"` then `routes: [health]`. `miu new` creates that layout:

```bash
miu new my-app          # app.ts, routes/health.ts, AGENTS.md, package.json, tsconfig.json
cd my-app && bun install
miu dev                 # bun --hot app.ts
miu test                # runs the `tests` exported by route files
miu inspect --json      # routes, schemas, plugins, MCP tools, Cloudflare bindings
```

`miu` finds the entry in this order: `app.ts`, `src/app.ts`, `index.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `app.tsx`, `src/app.tsx`. Pass a path (`miu test api/app.ts`) or `--entry` to override.

## Commands

```bash
miu dev [entry]                    # bun --hot <entry>, with MIU_ENV=development
miu test [entry]                   # run route tests; exit 1 if any fail
miu inspect [entry] [--json]       # readable route list, or the full app.inspect() JSON
miu openapi [entry] [--out f]      # print or write the OpenAPI 3.1 spec
miu check [entry]                  # leaked secrets (error) and unauthenticated mutations (warning)
miu add route|job|room|plugin <name>   # scaffold routes/, jobs/, rooms/ or plugins/<name>.ts
miu new <dir>                      # new project in an empty folder
miu deploy cloudflare [--dry-run] [--force] [--out wrangler.toml] [--entry app.ts] [--compatibility-date YYYY-MM-DD]
miu db pull | migrate ...          # see below
miu loadtest <ws-url> --action '{"type":"inc","data":{}}' [--players 10] [--duration 10s] [--rate 5] [--json]
miu help                           # also: miu <command> --help
```

- `miu check` scans `.ts/.js/.json/.toml/.yaml/.env` files for API keys and private keys (`MIU_W_SECRET_IN_CODE`, exit 1) and warns about POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes without `auth` (`MIU_W_UNAUTHENTICATED_MUTATION`, exit 0).
- `miu add route users/get-profile` writes `routes/users/get-profile.ts` with a handler that throws `MIU_E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and a failing test. It refuses to overwrite files.
- `miu loadtest` drives N simulated `@miujs/realtime` room clients and prints p50/p95/p99 latency from action to the next state patch.

`miu help` also lists `miu logs`, more `deploy` targets, `new --template` choices and a type check in `miu check`. In the current source those are not wired up yet: `logs` is rejected as an unknown command, `deploy` accepts only `cloudflare`, and `--template` and `--no-types` are accepted but have no effect.

## Database migrations

```bash
miu db pull --db app.sqlite --out schema.ts         # introspect into a Drizzle schema.ts
miu db pull --d1 my-db --json                       # describe a remote D1 database
miu db migrate --db app.sqlite                      # apply migrations/NNNN_name.sql not yet run
miu db migrate --d1 my-db --dir migrations          # same, through wrangler d1 execute --remote
miu db migrate --generate add_posts --schema db/schema.ts
```

Applied migrations are recorded in `_miu_migrations` (the same table `db({ migrations })` uses at runtime). Wrangler's `d1 migrations apply` keeps its own `d1_migrations` table, so pick one tool per database. `--generate` diffs your Drizzle tables against the database (or the replayed migrations) and writes the next file; destructive changes are printed, never written. Without `--db`, the only `*.sqlite`/`*.db` file in the folder is used.

## Programmatic use

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { runCli } from "@miujs/cli";

const lines: string[] = [];
const code = await runCli(["inspect", "--json"], {
  cwd: process.cwd(),
  out: (line) => lines.push(line),
  err: (line) => console.error(line),
  // run: a custom Runner for wrangler/bunx calls (tests inject one so nothing spawns)
});
console.log(code, lines.join("\n"));
```

`runCli(args, io)` returns the exit code. Also exported: `parseArgs`, `CliError`, `defaultRunner`, `wranglerToml`, `wranglerD1`, `inlineParams`.

## Options

Flags per command (anything else is `MIU_E_CLI_UNKNOWN_FLAG`). Value flags accept `--flag value` or `--flag=value`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--entry` | path | first of `app.ts`, `src/app.ts`, `index.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `app.tsx`, `src/app.tsx` | App entry (dev, test, inspect, openapi, check, deploy). |
| `--json` | bool | `false` | Machine-readable output (inspect, db pull, loadtest). |
| `--out` | path | stdout (openapi), `wrangler.toml` (deploy), `schema.ts` (db pull) | Output file. |
| `--dry-run` | bool | `false` | deploy: write and print `wrangler.toml`, run nothing. |
| `--force` | bool | `false` | deploy: overwrite an existing `wrangler.toml`. |
| `--compatibility-date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | today, capped at what the `workerd` in `node_modules` supports | deploy cloudflare: `compatibility_date`. An older local wrangler refuses dates newer than its workerd. |
| `--db` | path | the only `*.sqlite`/`*.db` file in cwd | db: local SQLite file. |
| `--d1` | string | none | db: remote D1 database name (`bunx wrangler d1 execute --remote --json`). |
| `--dir` | path | `migrations` | db migrate: folder of `NNNN_name.sql` files. |
| `--generate` | string | none | db migrate: write the next migration with this name. |
| `--schema` | path | none | db migrate `--generate`: module exporting Drizzle tables. |
| `--players` | integer | `10` | loadtest: simulated clients. |
| `--duration` | duration | `10s` | loadtest: `10s`, `500ms`, `2m`. |
| `--rate` | integer | `5` | loadtest: actions per second per client. |
| `--action` | JSON | required | loadtest: room message (or array of them) each client sends. |

## Errors

The CLI prints `error <CODE>: <message>` and a `fix:` line, then exits 1.

- `MIU_E_CLI_UNKNOWN_COMMAND`, `MIU_E_CLI_UNKNOWN_FLAG`, `MIU_E_CLI_FLAG_VALUE`: bad command line.
- `MIU_E_CLI_NO_APP`: no entry file found ([docs](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cli_no_app)).
- `MIU_E_CLI_NO_DEFAULT_EXPORT`: the entry does not `export default miu(...)`.
- `MIU_E_CLI_EXISTS`: a file or folder would be overwritten.
- `MIU_E_CLI_ADD_USAGE`, `MIU_E_CLI_NEW_USAGE`, `MIU_E_CLI_LOADTEST_USAGE`, `MIU_E_CLI_DB_USAGE`: missing arguments.
- `MIU_E_CLI_DEPLOY_TARGET`: a deploy target other than `cloudflare`.
- `MIU_E_CLI_DB_NOT_FOUND`, `MIU_E_CLI_DB_SOURCE`: the database file is missing or ambiguous.
- `MIU_E_CLI_WRANGLER`: `wrangler d1 execute` failed or printed non-JSON.
- `MIU_E_CLI_SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND`, `MIU_E_CLI_SCHEMA_EMPTY`, `MIU_E_CLI_DRIZZLE_MISSING`: problems with `--schema`.
- Any `MIU_E_*` error the app throws while loading (for example a route config error) is printed the same way.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

`miu deploy cloudflare` sets `MIU_TARGET=cloudflare`, loads the app so plugins choose their Workers adapters, and writes `wrangler.toml` from `app.inspect().cloudflare`: KV namespaces, D1 databases, R2 buckets, queue producers and consumers, Durable Object bindings with a `new_sqlite_classes` migration, cron triggers, `[assets]`, `[ai]`, `[[vectorize]]`, `[[workflows]]` and `[[ratelimits]]`. It then runs `bunx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml` (needs `wrangler login`). Re-run it after adding plugins. Secrets are not written; set them with `wrangler secret put`. `miu db ... --d1` talks to remote D1 through wrangler. The CLI itself never runs on Workers.

## Links

- [Getting started guide](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/guide.md)
- [Error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cli/src)
- [Tests](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/cli/test)
- [miujs](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/miujs/README.md), [@miujs/db](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/db/README.md), [@miujs/realtime](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/README.md), [@miujs/queue](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/queue/README.md)

<!-- source: packages/auth/README.md -->

# @miujs/auth

> Email and password accounts, API tokens, roles, rate-limited sign-in and password hashing for MiuJS, on top of @miujs/session.

`auth()` adds register, login, logout, `me` and API token routes under `/auth`, and sets `ctx.user` from the session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. The core then enforces each route's `auth` setting (`"required"`, `"optional"`, `{ role }`). Users live in a `UserStore`: `memoryUserStore()` for dev and tests, `dbUserStore(db)` (SQLite or D1 via `@miujs/db`) for real apps. Use it whenever an app has user accounts; it needs `session()` earlier in `plugins`.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/auth @miujs/session @miujs/db miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { session } from "@miujs/session";
import { auth, memoryUserStore } from "@miujs/auth";

const dashboard = route.get("/dashboard", {
  auth: "required",
  handler: ({ user }) => ({ hello: user.email ?? user.id }),
});

const admin = route.get("/admin", { auth: { role: "admin" }, handler: () => "admin ok" });

export default miu({
  name: "accounts",
  plugins: [session(), auth({ users: memoryUserStore() })],
  routes: [dashboard, admin],
});
```

Then, from a browser on the same origin or from curl:

```bash
curl -X POST localhost:3000/auth/register -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"ann@example.com","password":"correct horse battery","name":"Ann"}'
```

## Routes

All paths are under `basePath` (default `/auth`). Sign-in routes are not exposed as MCP tools.

| Route | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /auth/register` | `{ email, password, name? }`. Creates a user and signs in (201). 409 `MIU_E_AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN` if the email exists. Off with `register: false`. |
| `POST /auth/login` | `{ email, password }`. Signs in and regenerates the session id. |
| `POST /auth/logout` | Destroys the session. |
| `GET /auth/me` | The signed-in user: `{ user: { id, email, name, roles } }`. |
| `POST /auth/tokens` | `{ name, expiresInDays? }`. Creates an API token for the signed-in user; the token is returned once (201). |
| `DELETE /auth/tokens/:id` | Revokes one of your tokens. |

With a mailer (`auth({ mailer })` or `mail()` from `@miujs/mail` in `plugins`), these are added:

| Route | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /auth/password/forgot` | `{ email }`. Emails a reset link. Always 202, whether or not the account exists. |
| `POST /auth/password/reset` | `{ token, password }`. Sets the password, signs out other sessions, deletes the user's API tokens, signs in. Links expire after 1 hour and work once. |
| `POST /auth/password/change` | `{ currentPassword, newPassword }`, signed in. Other sessions are signed out; API tokens are kept. |
| `POST /auth/verify-email/request` | Emails a new confirmation link (only when `emailVerification` is not `"off"`). |
| `POST /auth/verify-email` | `{ token }`. Confirms the address. Links expire after 24 hours. |

`emailVerification: "optional"` sends a link on register and sets `ctx.user.emailVerified`. `"required"` also blocks sign-in until the address is confirmed, and register always answers 202 `{ status: "check-your-email" }` so it cannot be used to test which emails have accounts.

## Users in a database

`dbUserStore` creates its tables on first use (`authMigrations`); pass `{ migrate: false }` if you run migrations yourself.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { sqlite } from "@miujs/db";
import { session } from "@miujs/session";
import { auth, dbUserStore } from "@miujs/auth";

export default miu({
  plugins: [
    session(),
    auth({ users: dbUserStore(sqlite("app.db")), defaultRoles: ["member"], minPasswordLength: 12 }),
  ],
});
```

On Workers use `dbUserStore(d1("DB"))` with `d1` from `@miujs/db`.

## API tokens

`POST /auth/tokens` returns a token like `miu_<43 base64url chars>` once. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; an unknown, expired or malformed token gives 401 `MIU_E_AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID`. Requests with a bearer token and no session cookie are not subject to the session CSRF check. Change the prefix with `tokenPrefix` so leaked tokens are easy to scan for.

## Passwords

Passwords are hashed with argon2id when `Bun.password` exists, otherwise PBKDF2-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations in Django's `pbkdf2_sha256$...` format. `verifyPassword` also accepts Django PBKDF2 hashes and, on Bun, bcrypt (`$2a$`, `$2b$`, `$2y$`) and argon2 hashes. On login, a hash that is not in the preferred format is replaced (`needsRehash`). Passwords must be `minPasswordLength` (default 8) to 1024 characters.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { hashPassword, needsRehash, verifyPassword } from "@miujs/auth";

const opts = { algorithm: "pbkdf2" as const };
const hash = await hashPassword("correct horse battery", opts);
const ok = await verifyPassword("correct horse battery", hash, opts); // true
const upgrade = needsRehash(hash, opts); // false
console.log(ok, upgrade);
```

## Security defaults

- **Sessions:** login, register and password reset call `session.regenerate()` (no session fixation). A password reset or change bumps the user's session version, which signs out older sessions.
- **Login CSRF:** register, login, logout and the email/password routes are tagged `csrf-always`, so `session()` rejects cross-site browser requests (403 `MIU_E_CSRF`) even without a cookie. Clients that send no `Origin` still work.
- **Brute force:** on by default. Login: 10 per IP+account, 50 per account, 100 per IP per 15 minutes. Register: 10 per IP per hour. Password reset and verify-email requests: 5 per account and 20 per IP per hour. Over the limit gives 429 `MIU_E_RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`. `rateLimit: false` turns it off.
- **Client IP:** `ctx.ip` (Cloudflare's address on Workers, the socket address on Bun). Behind your own proxy, prefer core's `miu({ trustProxy })`; `rateLimit.trustProxyHeader` still works but is deprecated.
- **Account enumeration:** login gives the same error (401 `MIU_E_AUTH_INVALID`) and does the same hashing work for unknown emails and wrong passwords. Register returns 409 for a taken email unless `emailVerification: "required"`.
- **Emailed links:** built from `appUrl` or `env.APP_URL`, never from the Host header outside dev. One-time tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes.
- **Turnstile:** `turnstile: {}` checks a Cloudflare Turnstile token (`cf-turnstile-response` body field or header) on register and login, using `env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` by default.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { session } from "@miujs/session";
import { auth, memoryUserStore } from "@miujs/auth";

export default miu({
  plugins: [
    session(),
    auth({
      users: memoryUserStore(),
      rateLimit: { login: { perIpAccount: 5, windowSeconds: 600 } },
      turnstile: {},
    }),
  ],
});
```

## OAuth and passkeys

These are exported and tested but still being extended; check [the source](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/auth/src) before relying on details.

- `oauth: { google, github, apple, discord, oidc: [...] }` adds `GET /auth/oauth/:provider` and its `/callback` (authorization code with PKCE, state and nonce). Register `<appUrl>/auth/oauth/<id>/callback` at each provider. A provider identity is only linked to an existing account when both emails are verified.
- `passkeys: { rpId, rpName, origins }` adds WebAuthn registration and sign-in under `/auth/passkeys`.

Both need a store with the extra methods (`memoryUserStore()` and `dbUserStore()` have them).

## Options

`auth(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `users` | `UserStore` | `memoryUserStore()` | Where users and tokens live. Use `dbUserStore(db)` in real apps. |
| `basePath` | `string` | `"/auth"` | Prefix for all auth routes. |
| `password` | `PasswordOptions` | `{}` | `{ algorithm?: "argon2id" \| "pbkdf2", iterations?, workersCpuMs? }`. Default argon2id on Bun, else PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations. `workersCpuMs` is your Workers CPU limit per request (default 10, the Free plan) or `false`; see [Cloudflare Workers](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/auth/README.md#cloudflare-workers). |
| `defaultRoles` | `string[]` | `[]` | Roles given to newly registered users. |
| `minPasswordLength` | `number` | `8` | Minimum password length (maximum is 1024). |
| `register` | `boolean` | `true` | Serve `POST /register`. |
| `turnstile` | `TurnstileOptions` | off | `{ secretKey?, fetch? }`. Secret defaults to `env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`. |
| `tokenPrefix` | `string` | `"miu_"` | Prefix for API tokens. |
| `rateLimit` | `RateLimitOptions \| false` | on, see above | `{ limiter?, login?, register?, passwordReset?, verifyEmail?, trustProxyHeader? }`. |
| `mailer` | `AuthMailer` | `ctx.mail` from `mail()` | Sends verify and reset emails. Enables the password routes. |
| `appUrl` | `string` | `env.APP_URL` (request origin in dev only) | Public URL for emailed links. Required in production when emails are on. |
| `emailVerification` | `"off" \| "optional" \| "required"` | `"off"` | Email confirmation mode. |
| `emails` | `Partial<AuthEmails>` | `defaultAuthEmails` | Replace the verify, reset and already-registered email texts. |
| `pages` | `{ verifyEmail?, resetPassword?, forgotPassword? }` | `/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/forgot-password` | App pages that emailed links open. |
| `oauth` | `OAuthOptions` | off | OAuth / OpenID Connect providers. |
| `passkeys` | `PasskeyOptions` | off | Passkey (WebAuthn) sign-in. |

`rateLimit.limiter` is `memoryRateLimiter()` by default, or `cloudflareRateLimiter("BINDING")`.

## In @miujs/admin

`auth()` has a management section (`manage()`), shown by `@miujs/admin`:

- **Status**: user count, sign-ups, sign-ins and failed sign-ins since the instance started, sign-in methods (names only), password hashing parameters, email verification mode, login rate limit.
- **Users list** (paged, search by email): disable / enable (a disabled user is signed out, cannot sign in, and their API tokens stop working until enabled), sign out everywhere, revoke API tokens, send a password reset email (with a mailer), unlink an OAuth provider (never the last way to sign in).
- **Settings** (apply at once, in this instance): allow sign-ups (password and OAuth; existing users always sign in), minimum password length, login lockout thresholds.

Nothing there shows password hashes, tokens, reset links or provider secrets. Custom `UserStore`s get the list and row actions by implementing `countUsers`, `listUsers`, `setUserDisabled` and `revokeSessions` (the built-in stores have them; `dbUserStore` adds `users.disabled_at` in migration `miu_auth_004_disabled`).

## Errors

- [`MIU_E_AUTH_INVALID`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_invalid): 401, wrong email or password.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_token_invalid): 401, bad or expired API token.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_email_taken): 409 on register.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_PASSWORD_WEAK`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_password_weak): 400, password too short or too long.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_PASSWORD_INCORRECT`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_password_incorrect): 403, wrong current password on change.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_email_unverified): 403, sign-in before confirming the email (`"required"` mode).
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_VERIFY_INVALID`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_verify_invalid) / [`MIU_E_AUTH_RESET_INVALID`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_reset_invalid): 400, link invalid, used or expired.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_SESSION_REQUIRED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_session_required): `session()` missing or after `auth()` in `plugins`.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_MAILER_MISSING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_mailer_missing) / [`MIU_E_AUTH_APP_URL_MISSING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_app_url_missing): email features on without a mailer or public URL.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_TURNSTILE_FAILED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_turnstile_failed): 403, bot check failed.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_RATELIMIT_BINDING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_ratelimit_binding): `cloudflareRateLimiter` binding not configured.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_HASH_UNSUPPORTED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_hash_unsupported): bcrypt or argon2 hash outside Bun.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_STORE_UNSUPPORTED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_store_unsupported): the user store lacks methods a feature needs.
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_account_disabled): 403, an operator disabled this account (only after the password matched).
- [`MIU_E_AUTH_SIGNUPS_CLOSED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_signups_closed) / [`MIU_E_AUTH_OAUTH_SIGNUPS_CLOSED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_auth_oauth_signups_closed): 403, an operator closed sign-ups; existing users still sign in.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

- `dbUserStore(d1("DB"))` declares a `d1` binding for `miu deploy cloudflare`.
- The default memory rate limiter counts per isolate, so limits are approximate on Workers. Use `rateLimit: { limiter: cloudflareRateLimiter("LOGIN_LIMIT") }`: `auth().cloudflare()` then declares a `[[ratelimits]]` binding with the login per-IP+account limit and a 60-second period. The binding's own limit applies to every rule. A missing binding fails with `MIU_E_AUTH_RATELIMIT_BINDING` rather than leaving login unprotected.
- `APP_URL` and `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` are read from `env` per request, so the missing-`APP_URL` check happens when the first link is built.
- Passwords use PBKDF2 via Web Crypto on Workers (no `Bun.password`), so bcrypt and argon2 legacy hashes cannot be verified there.

### PBKDF2 and the Workers CPU limit

One PBKDF2-SHA256 hash at the default 600,000 iterations costs about 250 ms of CPU on workerd. Sign-up, sign-in (which may also rehash) and password changes each hash at least once. The Workers Free plan allows 10 ms of CPU per request; Paid plans default to 30,000 ms and let you set the limit with `[limits] cpu_ms` in `wrangler.toml`. auth() does not lower the iteration count for you. Instead:

- **Startup warning.** On Workers (and under `miu deploy cloudflare`), auth() logs one warning when a hash is estimated to cost more than `password.workersCpuMs` (default 10). The warning lists the options below. Set `workersCpuMs` to your plan's limit once it is high enough, or to `false` to turn the check off.
- **`miu deploy cloudflare`** writes `[limits] cpu_ms` when `auth().cloudflare()` asks for it: four hashes' worth (a verify plus a rehash, doubled for headroom), 1,100 ms at 600,000 iterations, or `workersCpuMs` if that is higher. The Free plan cannot set this. On Paid it replaces the 30,000 ms default, so raise it if other routes need more.

Pick one:

1. **Workers Paid with a CPU limit** (recommended). Keep 600,000 iterations and deploy with the generated `[limits] cpu_ms`. Then pass `auth({ password: { workersCpuMs: 1100 } })` so the warning goes away.
2. **Fewer iterations.** Pass `auth({ password: { iterations } })`. About 23,000 iterations fit in 10 ms. That makes a leaked hash about 25 times cheaper to guess offline than OWASP's 600,000. Existing hashes keep working, and `needsRehash` only upgrades a hash, never downgrades it.
3. **No passwords on Workers.** Sign users in with passkeys or OAuth, or delegate sign-in to an external identity provider.

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)
